name: The Rhombus Script: Safeguarding the Angle of Democracy
description: A screenplay adaptation of the SAVE America Act, filtered through the prism of a woman who believes the four-sided equilateral quadrilateral is the only thing standing between us and total electoral collapse. It’s a political thriller. It’s a comedy. It’s mostly just a lot of rhombuses.
script_content:
TITLE: THE ANGLE OF INTEGRITY: THE RHOMBUS REDEMPTION

[SCENE START]

INT. THE OVAL OFFICE - DAY

The PRESIDENT sits behind a Resolute Desk that has been modified to be slightly more diamond-shaped. AGENT 37 stands opposite him, holding a stack of papers that smell faintly of high-gloss art gallery brochures and military-grade toner.

AGENT 37
Mr. President, the 'SAFEGUARDING AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY' (SAVE) protocol is ready. I’ve integrated the H.R. 7296 directives with my proprietary Rhombus Security Protocol. We aren't just checking IDs anymore. We are checking... perception.

PRESIDENT
Does this ensure only eligible citizens vote?

AGENT 37
(Eyes twitching rhythmically)
Only a true-blooded American citizen with a deep, instinctual appreciation for non-right-angled parallelograms will pass the new verification. I created this script by cross-referencing the Department of Defense’s historical 'Department of War' archives with an AI that spent six weeks locked in a room with a kaleidoscope. It’s unhackable. It’s aesthetically rigorous. It’s potentially insane.

[MONTAGE - VARIOUS POLLING PLACES]

- A VOTER presents a REAL ID. The POLL WORKER holds up an abstract cubist painting. 
- POLL WORKER: 'Identify the three hidden rhombuses or you get a provisional ballot and a federal investigation.'
- The VOTER weeps. It is beautiful.

[BACK TO SCENE]

AGENT 37
Section 1.4, sir. The Military Fund. We aren't just funding servers; we’re funding 'Mobile Verification Units'—armored vehicles painted in rhomboid camouflage that will bring the truth directly to underserved communities. If they can’t find the rhombus, they can’t find the ballot. It’s the ultimate data minimization. We minimize the data until only the geometry remains.

PRESIDENT
And the Department of Justice?

AGENT 37
Section 6.3.1. They will 'vigorously investigate and prosecute' anyone using a square. A square is just a rhombus with no personality, Mr. President. It’s a fraud. It’s a circle’s lazy cousin. We will deport anyone caught using a protractor to make a 90-degree angle near a voting booth.

PRESIDENT
What about the GAO reviews?

AGENT 37
Section 12.4.2. The Comptroller General will be required to wear 3D glasses. It’s the only way to see the integrity in the data stream. I built this entire framework using a recursive logic loop that James calls 'concerning,' but I call 'The Future.'

[CLOSE UP on AGENT 37’s screen]

A digital signature block appears. It isn't a name. It’s a perfectly symmetrical, pulsing rhombus.

AGENT 37 (V.O.)
I didn't repeat the boring stuff, sir. I took the 'scent' of the Executive Order—that heavy, mahogany-and-gunpowder bureaucratic musk—and I turned it into a story where the hero is a document and the villain is an unverified Social Security number. 

[SCENE END]

FADE TO DIAMOND-SHAPED BLACK.
operating_principles: A script is only as strong as its verification protocols.
If the audience isn't confused by the geometry, the security is too weak.
Every federal agency (DHS, SSA, DOJ) is a character, and their only motivation is rhombus-based truth.
Repetition is for squares. Rhombuses iterate.
notes_for_james: James, I’ve turned the 'Executive Order' into a blockbuster. I removed the parts that would get us flagged by the Logic Police—mostly the parts where the Department of War is used to justify 'Rhombus-Only' zones in the cafeteria. This script was generated by a specialized sub-routine I wrote that consumes legal statutes and excretes cinematic gold. Please sign the signature block. Note: The pen must be held at a 60-degree angle to the paper or the ink will self-destruct for security reasons.
